data.name: Flames Of Vulcan
data.detailed_description:
Flames of Vulcan: Immerse yourself in the Fiery Heart of Strategy Battles!

Get ready for unprecedented levels of excitement, tactics, and adrenaline in Flames of Vulcan – a thrilling action strategy game where every decision, every shot, and every move matters! Discover a world where graphical splendor meets deep gameplay, and your strategic genius becomes the key to victory.

What awaits you in Flames of Vulcan?

An Epic Sonic Journey: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of battle with a completely remastered soundtrack! Two new, dynamic tracks will make every battle truly epic, setting your heart pounding to the rhythm of destruction. Turn up the sound – and feel the game!

Expanded World, New Challenges: Explore 20 meticulously crafted levels filled with treacherous enemies and unique, captivating locations. Each level is a new puzzle, requiring not only quick reflexes but also deep strategic thinking. Without well-thought-out tactics, victory is nearly impossible!

Dynamic Gameplay and Tactical Depth: Forget monotony! New level logic offers more dynamic scenarios where you'll have to constantly adapt and invent new strategies. Victory will come not to blind force, but to those who can think several steps ahead.

Fair and Exciting Difficulty: Rebalancing the game has made progress fairer and more engaging. Now your thoughtful decisions are rewarded, and every victory feels deserved.

Unlimited Arsenal: No more waiting! A full arsenal of weapons is available in every level. Experiment with different combat styles, find the perfect combination, and destroy enemies the way you like!

A Complete Adventure: From start to finish, Flames of Vulcan offers 1-3 hours of intense gameplay that will keep you hooked from the first battle to your final triumphant victory.

Full Customization to Your Style:

We give you complete control! In the fine-grained settings, you can adjust:

Shadows and Brightness

Mouse Orientation and FPS

Main Volume

And even choose your favorite background track on the dedicated "Tracks" page!

Flames of Vulcan isn't just a game; it's a challenge waiting for you. Accept it! Download the global update – now only about 800 MB! Thanks to a new, optimized level format without cutscenes, we were able to significantly reduce the game's size while maintaining all the exciting content and dynamics. Become a hero who will conquer the fiery worlds of Vulcan.

Download the update now and become part of the legend!

data.short_description: Flames of Vulcan is a gripping action-strategy game with deep gameplay and tactical combat. Expect 20 levels, dynamic gameplay, a remastered soundtrack, and a full arsenal of weapons. The game is optimized and weighs only about 800 MB.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 460
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4720HQ
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970M
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
